title: Puchong Half Marathon 2026 Review: JomRun's Selangor Suburb 21K
seo_title: Puchong Half Marathon 2026 Review | JomRun Selangor Malaysia
meta_description: The Puchong Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun: October 25 at AEON BiG Puchong Utama, Selangor. 21K, 10K, 5K with registration open.
dek: Set for 25 October 2026 at AEON BiG Puchong Utama in Selangor, this JomRun-powered half marathon offers three distances with registration open. A convenient Klang Valley suburb race.
verdict: The Puchong Half Marathon Powered by JomRun is a convenient, accessible Klang Valley suburb race — anchored at AEON BiG Puchong Utama, a retail location with ample parking and facilities. Three distances (21K, 10K, 5K) with registration open via JomRun. Puchong is one of Selangor's largest population centres, roughly 30 minutes south of KL, making this a practical choice for Klang Valley runners looking for a low-friction race-day experience.

sections.heading: Puchong: KL's Southern Suburb
paragraphs: Puchong is one of the Klang Valley's most populous suburbs, with a large running community and easy access from KL and Petaling Jaya. [1] The AEON BiG mall-anchored venue provides the familiar practical advantages: parking, pre-race shelter, and post-race food options.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A convenient Klang Valley half marathon with JomRun registration. 25 October 2026 at AEON BiG Puchong Utama. [1]

faqs.question: When is the Puchong Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: 25 October 2026 at AEON BiG Puchong Utama, Selangor, Malaysia. It offers 5K, 10K, and 21.1K. Registration is currently open. Mark it on your calendar if you're planning your racing year around it. [1]
